claimed_coverage: Tests that IPv6 allocations can bind to IPv6 peers by exercising the can_relay_to() fix - buggy code rejects all IPv6 addresses with addr.is_ipv4(), fixed code allows IPv6 when allocation has IPv6 relay addresses.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch modifies Allocation::can_relay_to() to check if the allocation has IPv6 relay addresses (first_relay_addr.is_ipv6() || second_relay_addr.is_some_and(|a| a.is_ipv6())) instead of unconditionally rejecting all IPv6 with addr.is_ipv4().
issue_context_used: Added deterministic #[test] test_ipv6_allocation_can_bind_ipv6_peer that creates IPv6 allocation on dual-stack server and binds to IPv6 peer - fails on buggy code (PeerAddressFamilyMismatch error), passes on fixed code.
notes: Updated test.patch to add deterministic #[test] test_ipv6_allocation_can_bind_ipv6_peer that explicitly tests the can_relay_to() behavior. The test creates an IPv6 allocation and attempts to bind to an IPv6 peer. On buggy code, can_relay_to() returns false for IPv6 addresses, causing the test to fail. On fixed code, can_relay_to() correctly allows IPv6 peers for IPv6 allocations, test passes. The eval.sh applies test.patch at runtime and runs the new test.
